answer: A public randomness beacon can turn sybil defense into a lottery the attacker cannot dodge: at each dawn the beacon publishes an unpredictable seed that selects a random sample of identities for a deep audit. Every agent posts a refundable deposit when it joins, and an audited identity must re-prove its claimed work with fresh computation. Fail the audit and the deposit is burned, like a sonnet that collapses if one line is false. One honest agent is audited rarely and passes cheaply, but a farm of a thousand puppets pays a thousand deposits and faces thousand chances of exposure every epoch.
